transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Thursday, September 24. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. LoP's presence in panel to pick CEC, ECs 'ornamental': SC judge. 'Drawbacks in appointment law give overwhelming power to executive' DoorDash agrees to $131.5m after payment errors affected 200,000-plus NYC workers. DoorDash will pay $131.5 million to settle a probe regarding its payment practices for delivery workers. The settlement will directly benefit over 260,000 Dashers, addressing both missing and late payments. An additional dispute over calculation methods for on-call pay times has also been resolved in this agreement. DoorDash has acknowledged the issues caused by technical errors and improved its payment processes. Roshibina Devi wins silver, falls short against China's Xiaoyu in final. Naorem Roshibina Devi has proudly secured a silver medal in the women's sanda 60kg event at the Asian Games, representing India. She faced China's Zhang Xiaoyu in the final and lost with a score of 0-2, after Zhang decisively won both rounds. This victory adds to Roshibina's impressive record, marking her second silver at consecutive Asian Games since her setback in the 2022 Hangzhou final. George Floyd's siblings seek accounting of $14.7m memorial GoFundMe. After George Floyd's untimely death in 2020, a fundraising campaign on GoFundMe amassed millions to support his family. However, his siblings are now pressing for a comprehensive audit of the funds raised, alleging an inequitable distribution of the contributions. They have called on Philonise Floyd to produce various financial records linked to the campaign. This unfolding situation emphasizes the critical importance of accountability in the handling of considerable charitable donations. Trump receives Xi Jinping at airport as Chinese prez begins 3-day US visit: What's on agenda. Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Washington on Wednesday for a three-day state visit, receiving a rare airport welcome from US President Donald Trump as the two leaders prepare for talks on trade, technology, artificial intelligence, military ties, Iran, Taiwan, the Russia 8 US Navy sailors attempted suicide during USS Lincoln's Iran deployment. Eight US Navy personnel assigned to the USS Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group attempted suicide during its lengthy deployment, including a period in which the group conducted combat operations against Iran, Acting US Navy Secretary Hung Cao told Congress. N Chandrasekaran's real vote test: Tata Sons AGM, not boardroom. Majority owner will swing resolutions on reappointment; ban does not apply to sdtt After split verdict, SC refers law on EC appointment to larger bench. On a day when Election Commission found itself under the scanner, a two-judge bench of Supreme Court gave a split verdict on whether the issue of validity of the law on appointment of CEC/ECs be referred to a constitution bench, but later agreed to refer the case to a larger bench for the sake of early adjudication of the contentious issue. Benedict Arnold's crypt now part of kindergarten classroom. Benedict Arnold rose to major general and earned George Washington's trust during the American Revolution before switching allegiance to Britain. He moved to England and died there in 1801, aged 60. Arnold was buried in St. Mary's Church in Battersea, where his crypt eventually became part of a basement now used as a private kindergarten classroom. Elk herd in Smokies grows from 25 to 250+ in 25 years after reintroduction. In 2001, 25 elk were reintroduced to Great Smoky Mountains National Park from Kentucky, followed by 27 more from Canada in 2002. Twenty-five years later, more than 250 elk have been recorded in the Smokies. Wildlife experts and former rangers describe the reintroduction as a major conservation success, while the herd continues expanding into new areas. Salesforce CEO blames Microsoft for not investing in OpenAI. Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff says Microsoft's stake in OpenAI stopped his company from investing in the ChatGPT maker. Speaking on Alex Heath's Sources podcast, Benioff said Sam Altman turned him down, pushing Salesforce towards rival Anthropic. That early 2023 bet is reportedly worth about $5 billion, and Benioff believes it could earn Salesforce tens of billions as Claude maker Anthropic prepares for a public listing.

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. Good news: Property purchase from NRIs gets easier as govt amends Form 141; check how it helps. From October 1, 2026, Indian property buyers can buy properties from non-residents without getting a TAN. Instead a new system has been launched by the Finance Ministry under which the buyer needs to file Form 141 and fill Schedule E and then issue the TDS certificate in Form 132 to the non-resident. Earlier this system was very complicated, now it has been made comparatively easier. UP RERA approves 12 realty projects, worth investment of rupees 1,663.85 crore across six districts , Here's all we know. The Uttar Pradesh RERA has approved 12 new real estate projects, worth investment of rupees 1,663.85 crore across six districts in the state. The plan will comprise 3,090 residential and commercial units. Here's all we know... Bank strike: Will banks be open on September 26 and 27? What RBI and bank unions say. In a proactive measure, the Reserve Bank of India has granted approval for banks to remain open on Sunday, September 27, 2026. This strategic decision aims to support customers anticipating a three-day strike from September 28 through September 30, organized by the United Forum of Bank Unions. Although it remains unclear if banks will operate on Saturday, customers can secure essential services on September 27. Are Americans benefitting? Fed survey finds how US firms are using their Trump tariff refunds. A survey report by the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta said majority of the US firms who received or are seeking tariff refunds, plan to keep the funds as cash, invest it in R and D or new capital projects, use it to lower prices for a while or to give bonuses to workers or managers. 8th Pay Commission: AIDEF demands rupees 69,000 minimum pay, 3.83 fitment factor and 11-year pension commutation period. 8th Pay Commission news: AIDEF has put forth demands regarding family units and pay calculations for the 8th Pay Commission. They request a minimum salary of rupees 69,000 and a higher fitment factor. The federation seeks to restore the Old Pension Scheme and change the commuted pension duration to 11 years. Additionally, they want amendments for pension-related issues covering pensioners before 2026. Should you take a second home loan? Ask yourself these 3 questions before you take a call. The Ministry of Railways has announced the Unified Pension Scheme rules for employees covered under the National Pension System. Employees appointed after January 1, 2004, are eligible for this scheme and will contribute 10 percent of their basic pay. A minimum pension of rupees 10,000 is assured after completing ten years of service. Additionally, employees can opt for voluntary retirement after 20 years of service. With investments worth rupees 13.9 lakh, she aims to finance her master's education. From rupees 300 to rupees 25,000: How EPF wage ceiling has changed since 1952 and why it is important for you. The wage ceiling for the Employees' Provident Fund has officially increased to rupees 25,000, effective September 17, 2026. This much-needed revision is the first change in wage limits since 2014 and directly impacts mandatory EPF contributions for employees in the organized sector. Those earning up to the new wage ceiling can expect elevated contributions, which will aid in bolstering their retirement plans. NPCI dismisses speculation over GST burden due to UPI merchant discount rate as 'incorrect' , Here's what it said. The National Payments Corporation of India clarified that allegations regarding Goods and Services Tax (GST) on Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) burdening small merchants and making digital payments costly are incorrect. Will gives you property rights, but what next? Know these 7 steps to transfer ownership and secure possession. A Will plays a crucial role in outlining how assets will be allocated following an individual's death, which can lead to family disputes if disagreements arise about the testator's intentions. To facilitate property transfers, it is wise to gather important documents such as a no-objection affidavit and release deed. Keeping mutation records up to date and securing an encumbrance certificate is vital for tax purposes. Central government salary and pension to be paid on 25 September ahead of three-day bank strike. The Ministry of Finance will disburse salaries and pensions for September 2026 on the 25th due to a nationwide bank strike from September 28-30. This affects Central Government employees and pensioners, including those in Defence and Posts and Telecommunications. SBI Card launches FD-backed credit cards on YONO: Who is eligible?
